lines.en: I crawl on hands and feet together.
My joints bend the wrong way.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面过去，头先探。
lines.en: I go along the floor, head first.
My skin hangs loose.

lines.zh: 我爬过墙角，蹭掉一层皮。
lines.en: I crawl past the corner and shed a layer of skin.

lines.zh: 我不站起来，站着太显眼。
lines.en: I don't stand; standing is too obvious.
My nails scrape the floor.
I squeeze under the door.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把头转向声音。
lines.en: I stop and turn my head to the sound.

lines.zh: 我的背脊一节一节凸起。
lines.en: My spine ridges one segment at a time.

lines.zh: 我向前挪，肩膀一高一低。
lines.en: I creep forward, shoulders uneven.
I crawl around you, not entering the house.
I lie in the corner, still.
My skin is moving slowly.
I listen to the sounds in the house.
My fingers move one at a time.
I press my face to the wall.
I wait for you to turn off the light.
I watch you through a gap in my skin.
I stay still as a rag.
I fold my legs behind me.

lines.zh: 我在数这屋里有几个人。
lines.en: I count how many people are in this house.

lines.zh: 我把一条腿从背后翻过来。
lines.en: I fold a leg over from behind.

lines.zh: 我的皮在肩上一抽一抽。
lines.en: The skin on my shoulder twitches.
Your eyes have landed on me.
I lift my head; my neck is too long.
Your bed is low; I can reach it.
I am at your feet.
Do you smell me?
Don't look at the door.
My face is not a human face.
It is warm under your blanket.
I have counted your breaths.
I put my hand on your bed frame.
Listen — my joints are clicking.
Your ankle is right by my hand.
I watch you from under the bed edge.

lines.zh: 我是被召出来的，皮还新。
lines.en: I was summoned, and my skin is still new.

lines.zh: 我把手指一根根按在地上。
lines.en: I press my fingers to the floor one by one.
Don't lower that lamp.
I crawl to the block behind you.
Do you hear nails on the floor?

lines.zh: 我把脸从头发里露出来。
lines.en: I show my face through the hair.
My skin tore.
I pressed myself lower.
That set me back some distance.

lines.zh: 这层皮下面，什么都没有。
lines.en: Under this skin there's nothing at all.
My skin tore; I still crawl.
One side of my skin hangs loose.
I slowly shift back to the wall.

lines.zh: 这具身子，本来就借来的。
lines.en: This body was only borrowed to begin with.
That smell — is it meat?
Set it on the floor.
I don't use hands; I use my mouth.
Back into the corner.

lines.zh: 我闻得到你身上的味道。
lines.en: I can smell what's on you.
Not enough. You have more.
Turn off the light.
That skin you're wearing... it looks lovely.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的手，我缩回去。
lines.en: You stepped on my hand; I pulled it back.
My skin slipped.
Don't kick me.
I slip behind your feet.
You knocked a layer of skin off me.
I press against your leg, cold.

lines.zh: 我的手指勾住你的裤脚。
lines.en: My fingers hook your trouser hem.
You step back; I crawl forward.
There is a trail where I dragged myself.

lines.zh: 我这张皮是从别人身上来的。
lines.en: This skin came off someone else.
I cannot even stand straight.
You should be asleep. The lamps are out.
My kind needs none of that.
Don't touch my skin.
I only want to crawl to the bedside.
I listen while you speak.
I slowly retreat.
It'll be light soon; I must go back in the wall.
No hands. Teeth.
My fingers won't obey.
It slipped out of my hand.
I tuck it under my skin.
This could be something to sleep on.
I hook it with a nail.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我都能闻到。
lines.en: I can smell anything that falls.
This isn't quite enough.
I grind it with my back teeth, making a sound.
I hide it in a wall crack.
You turned over. I heard it.
I heard you get out of bed.
Don't turn on the light. I'm not ready.
I am right at the bedside.
Your foot touched the floor.
I have been waiting for you to wake.
I stretched my body out.
My fingers reach the bedpost.
Listen — that is skin rustling.

lines.zh: 床板下面，我的皮舒展开了。
lines.en: Under the bedboards, my skin unfurls.
I raise my head in the wrong order.
You got out of bed quietly.
I don't need to stand.

lines.zh: 我贴着床底，数你的脚步。
lines.en: I cling under the bed, counting your steps.

lines.zh: 我数到你床边有几块砖。
lines.en: I counted the tiles to your bed.
I follow along the floor.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我就爬两下。
lines.en: Each step you take, I crawl twice.
I am under the bed.

lines.zh: 你数过这房间有几个角吗。
lines.en: Have you counted the corners of this room?
I go around by the wardrobe.
You stepped on my finger.

lines.zh: 我不出声，你能听见我的皮。
lines.en: I make no sound; you can hear my skin.
One more step back and you reach the wall.
I wait behind the door.
I put my hand by your feet.
Almost at your feet.

lines.zh: 我顺着墙脚爬到另一边。
lines.en: I crawl along the skirting to the far side.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就爬两下。
lines.en: Each step you back, I crawl twice.
My shadow shows under the door.
You look for the lamp; I found you first.
My skin rasps on the boards.

lines.zh: 你头顶的房梁上也有东西。
lines.en: There is something on the beam above you.
I am under the table.

lines.zh: 你别弯腰，弯腰我就够到了。
lines.en: Don't bend down; then I can reach you.
My hand seizes your ankle.
That had my whole body behind it.
I climb onto your back.
My nails sink into your skin.

lines.zh: 我的关节响了一下，还是抓住了。
lines.en: My joint popped, and I held on.
One hand of mine is enough.
My hand is at your throat.

lines.zh: 我的下颌能张开到胸口。
lines.en: My jaw can open as wide as my chest.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在你的手背上。
lines.en: I bite the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 我的手指抓住你的手腕。
lines.en: My fingers clamp your wrist.
You are pulled down into a stoop.
I used my shoulder for that one.
My skin tangles around your foot.
I crawl out from under the bed.
My marks are on the floor.
This house smells of people.
I put my head around the corner.
The light is off. Good.
I spread out from under the bed.
I stop by the door.
Breathing is very near.
Fingers first, I begin to crawl.
My fingers land first.
This room is small.
I unfold slowly from the corner.
The floor of this house is cold.
My skin isn't settled yet.
I raise my head to bed height.
There are two windows here.

lines.zh: 我选了一个看不见的角落。
lines.en: I chose a corner you can't see.

lines.zh: 我把身体拉过两块地板。
lines.en: I stretch across two floorboards.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的皮，卷了起来。
lines.en: Fire catches my skin and it curls.

lines.zh: 我从床上摔下来，趴在地上。
lines.en: I fell off the bed and lay flat.

lines.zh: 水一浸，我的皮就贴在骨头上。
lines.en: Water soaks me and my skin clings to bone.
Something passed through my shoulder.
Spell-light makes my skin shine.

lines.zh: 太久没吃东西，我贴在骨头上。
lines.en: Too long without food; I cling to bone.
The flash lights the whole room.
The floor is gone and I fall.
